unit: electricity: US cents per kWh; gas: US dollars per thousand cubic feet
note: EIA residential prices: electricity August 2026 (and a year earlier), natural gas July 2026 (and a year earlier), for every state, DC and the U.S.; the month is in the item (electricity/YYYY-MM, gas/YYYY-MM). EIA publishes one average per state and month, so low/high/min/max repeat it and no record count is stored (n is empty).
